我的朋友利奥(My Friend Leo): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍米娅的日常、喜好与假期计划。
I am happy every day. Mia and Leo are in the same class. The spring market is big and clean. What's more, I bought a new pair of shoes.
Leo likes fish too. Mia usually eats fish for lunch. My friend Leo is very kind. Best of all, the child is playing in the park.
Leo often helps me with history. I like my life very much. Mia's favorite season is spring.
